objective: GATE 4A: preflight inmediatamente anterior a la implementacion de infraestructura universal definida en Gate 3. Confirmar existencia/ausencia, tipos exactos, PK/FK/indices/defaults de EXTEND_CANDIDATE y CREATE_CANDIDATE sin DDL/DML: Unidades_Negocio timezone_iana/locale_operativo; Sync_Control_Ejecuciones ConexionID/UnidadNegocioID/CodigoSync/UTC/IdempotencyKey; Servidores_ConexionEstado health; tablas Sistema_Sync_Capacidades, Sync_Control_Evidencias, Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos. Confirmar tipos exactos de claves referenciadas. No leer secretos. Production prohibida.

queries.name: gate4_target_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.name IN ('Unidades_Negocio','Sync_Control_Ejecuciones','Servidores_ConexionEstado','Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','Sync_Control_Evidencias','Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos') ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: gate4_target_columns_exact
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,c.is_computed,dc.name AS default_name,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=o.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE o.name IN ('Unidades_Negocio','Sync_Control_Ejecuciones','Servidores_ConexionEstado','Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','Sync_Control_Evidencias','Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos') ORDER BY o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: gate4_candidate_column_presence
queries.sql: SELECT o.name AS object_name,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE (o.name='Unidades_Negocio' AND c.name IN ('timezone_iana','locale_operativo')) OR (o.name='Sync_Control_Ejecuciones' AND c.name IN ('ConexionID','UnidadNegocioID','CodigoSync','StartedAtUTC','FinishedAtUTC','IdempotencyKey')) OR (o.name='Servidores_ConexionEstado' AND c.name IN ('UltimaPruebaUTC','UltimoExitoUTC','UltimoErrorUTC','UltimoErrorCodigo','UltimoErrorMensaje','LatenciaMs','UltimoSyncUTC','UltimoSyncExitosoUTC','FechaActualizacionUTC')) ORDER BY o.name,c.name

queries.name: gate4_pk_unique_keys
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,kc.name AS constraint_name,kc.type_desc,ic.key_ordinal,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length FROM sys.key_constraints kc JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=kc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=o.object_id AND ic.index_id=kc.unique_index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.name IN ('Unidades_Negocio','Sync_Control_Ejecuciones','Servidores_ConexionEstado','Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','Sync_Control_Evidencias','Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos') ORDER BY o.name,kc.name,ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: gate4_existing_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT ps.name AS parent_schema,pt.name AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,fk.name AS fk_name,rs.name AS ref_schema,rt.name AS ref_table,rc.name AS ref_column,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.tables pt ON pt.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas ps ON ps.schema_id=pt.schema_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=pt.object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables rt ON rt.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas rs ON rs.schema_id=rt.schema_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=rt.object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE pt.name IN ('Unidades_Negocio','Sync_Control_Ejecuciones','Servidores_ConexionEstado','Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','Sync_Control_Evidencias','Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos') OR rt.name IN ('Unidades_Negocio','Sync_Control_Ejecuciones','Servidores_ConexionEstado','Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_VersionesSistemas') ORDER BY pt.name,fk.name,fkc.constraint_column_id

queries.name: gate4_existing_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.has_filter,i.filter_definition,ic.key_ordinal,ic.is_included_column,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=i.object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE o.name IN ('Unidades_Negocio','Sync_Control_Ejecuciones','Servidores_ConexionEstado','Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','Sync_Control_Evidencias','Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos') AND i.index_id>0 ORDER BY o.name,i.name,ic.key_ordinal,ic.index_column_id

queries.name: gate4_sync_catalog_code_contract
queries.sql: SELECT o.name AS object_name,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.name='Sistema_Sync_Catalogo' AND c.name IN ('Codigo','CodigoSync','SyncCodigo','id','ID') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: gate4_capability_key_contract
queries.sql: SELECT o.name AS object_name,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.name='Sistema_Capacidades' AND (c.name LIKE '%Capacidad%ID%' OR c.name IN ('id','ID','SistemaTipoID')) ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: gate4_version_key_contract
queries.sql: SELECT o.name AS object_name,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.name='Sistema_VersionesSistemas' AND (c.name LIKE '%version%id%' OR c.name IN ('id','ID','sistema_version_id','SistemaTipoID')) ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: gate4_connection_health_columns_full
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=o.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE o.name='Servidores_ConexionEstado' ORDER BY c.column_id
